stories.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
stories.take: The Nasdaq fell more than 5% as investors bet a Democratic Congress and the states will crack down on AI and data centers — the election bill for tech came due on Wall Street.

stories.title: The AI backlash needs a plan
stories.take: Platformer argues Democrats now have a mandate to rein in frontier labs and data centers, and the hard part is doing it without repeating the social-media era's mistakes.

stories.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
stories.take: The Times keeps buying communities its readers already love — the film diary Letterboxd is the reported next $330 million piece of the bundle.

stories.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
stories.take: The platforms are suing to stop California's under-16 social media restrictions before they take effect next year.

stories.title: Blue Origin says it is building a higher-performing rocket engine at 1/4 the cost
stories.take: Blue Origin says its next engine delivers more performance at a quarter of the cost — if it holds, the launch economics shift again.

stories.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
stories.take: A password-free SSH login flaw hits certain Alpine Linux setups, and other distros may be exposed — check your exposed boxes.

stories.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
stories.take: Airbnb's planned agent will plan trips, compare options and manage bookings — travel planning is becoming an agent feature, not an app.

stories.title: Democrats Learned to Win the Social Feed After 2024’s Digital Drubbing
stories.take: El-Sayed, Talarico and Mamdani built followings on character as much as policy — the feed lesson of 2024 finally landed.

stories.title: The 2026 Political Ad Outlay Was the Dumbest Money Spent In the History of Advertising
stories.take: Adweek's verdict on a cycle of record political spending: a disgrace of waste that bought very little persuasion.

stories.title: Election Night 2026 Ratings: NBC News is the Most Watched Network
stories.take: NBC led broadcast on election night; Fox News topped cable in total viewers and CNN won the demo.

stories.title: McDonald’s US CMO steps down as sales decline
stories.take: McDonald's splits its top US marketing job between two longtime executives on an interim basis while it searches for a permanent CMO.

stories.title: In graphic detail: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem
stories.take: Six thousand brands in, ChatGPT ads are growing faster than the proof they convert — measurement is the bottleneck.

stories.title: How TF is the grocery store a media channel?
stories.take: Grocery retail media keeps expanding from endcaps to apps, and Digiday explains why the store itself is now the ad surface.

stories.title: Victor Wembanyama after historic 52-point, 24-rebound night: 'It should be more like this, more often'
stories.take: Wembanyama put up 52 and 24 and said he is finally getting his legs back after starting the season sick — a warning to the rest of the league.

stories.title: Super 8: Thompson's game-winning 3 completes Heat's dramatic comeback
stories.take: Klay Thompson hit his eighth 3 with one second left in overtime to finish Miami's comeback, 117-116 over the Clippers.

stories.title: Warriors withholding payments to Porzingis on $20M salary, sources say
stories.take: Golden State is withholding semimonthly pay from the absent Kristaps Porzingis, ruling he is not rendering services — a $20 million standoff.

stories.title: Lakers send little-used Bronny James to G League affiliate
stories.take: The 7-2 Lakers assigned Bronny James to their G League affiliate after using him sparingly — minutes will come in the valley, not Los Angeles.

stories.title: Even Nikola Jokic might not be able to save these Nuggets
stories.take: Denver's roster was never built to survive any slippage from its three-time MVP, and the early cracks are showing.

stories.title: Biggest MLB offseason questions: How long will lockout last? Will we see a free agency frenzy?
stories.take: Free agency opens under a labor cloud: the biggest winter question is how long a likely lockout lasts, not just who signs where.

stories.title: Pujols to interview for Astros' managerial opening, sources say
stories.take: Albert Pujols is expected to interview in Houston this week — the future Hall of Famer's managerial candidacy is getting serious.

stories.title: Ex-Guardians catcher Naylor: Nothing unusual about Clase, Ortiz pitches
stories.take: Bo Naylor testified he saw nothing unusual in the Clase and Ortiz pitches at the center of the rigging case.

stories.title: Athletics tab Brewers' Castro as new GM amid front office rebuild
stories.take: The A's hired Milwaukee's Cam Castro, its player-development chief, as GM in their front-office rebuild.

stories.title: ↔️ Free agency tracker: Offseason trades, moves
stories.take: The running tracker for every major hot-stove signing and trade as the offseason gets moving.

stories.title: US elections 2026 live: Democrats exceed 250 House seats as blue wave sweeping Congress grows
stories.take: Democrats passed 250 House seats as late flips landed in Ohio, Arizona and North Carolina; Ted Cruz called it a 'Watergate-level repudiation.'

stories.title: After taking control of Congress, Democrats vow major probes into Trump's 'tentacles of corruption'
stories.take: Corruption topped voter concerns, and the new Democratic majority says investigations come first.

stories.title: These are the races in the House and Senate that haven't been called yet
stories.take: A strong Democratic majority is set; the uncalled races will only set its final size.

stories.title: After midterms, Trump is left to weigh his next move in Iran war that contributed to GOP loss
stories.take: The Iran war helped cost Republicans Congress, and Trump's next move carries stakes for the region and the global economy.

stories.title: Head of Justice Department office on Civil Rights resigns
stories.take: Harmeet Dhillon is out after 18 tumultuous months running the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division.

stories.title: Alabama executes man for 1991 killings in last of 3 U.S. executions carried out the same day
stories.take: Alabama, Florida and Indiana all carried out executions on the same day, with Florida reaching a record-tying 19th of the year.

stories.title: California's contemplative governor-elect still mulling over how to lower prices, provide healthcare
stories.take: In his first press conference, Governor-elect Xavier Becerra stayed noncommittal on taxes, energy and healthcare — the campaign promises now meet the budget.

stories.title: Newsom moves to commute all California death sentences to life in prison without parole
stories.take: Newsom's plan would commute sentences for more than 500 condemned inmates and effectively empty California's death row.

stories.title: Nithya Raman defeats Bass to become next L.A. mayor
stories.take: Karen Bass conceded by phone on Thursday — Los Angeles chose Raman and a sharp change of direction at City Hall.

stories.title: Court rules against California’s first carbon capture project, a key piece of state climate plans
stories.take: A Kern County judge set aside approval of the state's first carbon capture project, finding its environmental review broke state law.

stories.title: Near 90 in November as Santa Anas bring fire risk plus heat, especially along the coast
stories.take: A weekend heat wave near 90 with Santa Ana winds brings red flag warnings back to Ventura and Los Angeles county mountains.

stories.title: Richard Barrera wins state superintendent race as Sonja Shaw concedes
stories.take: San Diego Unified board president Richard Barrera will lead California's schools after Sonja Shaw conceded.

stories.title: Why a Data Center Slowdown Benefits Big Tech
stories.take: The answer: a slowdown helps the hyperscalers — it gives Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Meta cover to trim CapEx they were already missing, and scarcity raises compute rents, margins and free cash flow • Builds continue, just pricier and more regulated: pay-your-own-energy, water and transparency rules • The market already split that way: MAG7 +$1 trillion while Nvidia fell 3% and CoreWeave 10% • Also: ChatGPT now handles 20% as many searches as Google, and Isomorphic Labs is raising $5B at a $50B valuation

stories.title: Oil companies pump it up
stories.take: Big oil is cashing in: ConocoPhillips posted $4B in Q3 earnings and US crude output hit a record 14M barrels a day, driven by the Permian • Refining margins spiked on the Middle East war, but companies are cautious on 2027 spending — oil could be $60 or $100 depending on geopolitics • GM and Hilton are moving to the Nasdaq, chasing Nasdaq-100 eligibility and tech credentials • AI is flooding academic journals with glossy, thin scholarship, editors say

stories.title: Meet the new Dems. Same as the old Dems?
stories.take: The answer: no, not the same — the new caucus is younger (average age 58.3 → 55.4), and both flanks grew: Blue Dogs nearly doubled to ~22 while Democratic Socialists went from 2 to 8 • What unites them is cost of living and corruption, with economic populism across the spectrum • Voters under 30 broke ~48 points for Democrats, a ~40-point shift from 2024 • The constraint is unchanged: Trump's veto and the Senate's 60-vote bar, with no veto-proof majority

stories.title: Musk, money, and data centers’ future after the ‘blue wave’
stories.take: Texas Governor-elect Hinojosa campaigned on a data-center moratorium and may let SpaceX's $17B fab walk to Arizona rather than keep its tax breaks • Musk spent ~$250M backing Texas Republicans and lost both the Senate seat and the governorship; Tesla and SpaceX shed $450B in two days • OpenAI's new community compact promises published power and water use and no NDAs with officials • Also: what a lame-duck Trump means for Iran and foreign policy

stories.title: Karen Bass concedes to Nithya Raman in LA mayor's race, Rep Jimmy Gomez ousted by challenger, Disney partnering with AI—Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Karen Bass conceded to Nithya Raman — the first LA mayoral challenger to oust an incumbent since Villaraigosa in 2005, and DSA-backed candidates will now run America's two largest cities • Rep. Jimmy Gomez was unseated by DSA challenger Angela Gonzales Torres in CA-34 • LA County courts will now provide audio records for 830,000+ hearings that had no word-for-word record • Disney Accelerator is testing AI filmmaking tools and park robots

stories.title: What led to Raman's victory, Newsom clears death row, Santa Ana supports tax raise — Evening Edition
stories.take: The answer: Bass's unpopularity drove it — unfavorability topping 60%, on homelessness, housing costs and her Palisades Fire response; Raman filed on the very last day and won 52–48 • Newsom will commute all 548 California death sentences to life without parole • Santa Ana voters back making the 1.5% sales tax permanent (~$85M a year) • Airbnb spent $6M+ backing losing candidates in the mayor and city attorney races

stories.title: Nasdaq Loses a Historic $2.5 Trillion in Market Cap in AI Rout After Election
stories.take: The Nasdaq lost a historic $2.5 trillion in market cap (down 5.5%, into correction) and the S&P 500 lost $2.9 trillion as fears of an AI build-out slowdown hit chips, power and software • Every S&P sector fell; Nvidia is now down for the year • The blue wave likely locks the Supreme Court's 6-3 makeup for at least two years — a Democratic Senate would block any Trump nominee, and Thomas and Alito show no sign of retiring • Flights across Europe were disrupted for a second day by bomb threats
